#Data load
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

survey_raw <- read_csv("C:/Users/aderosa/OneDrive - Metropolitan Area Planning Council/Digital Equity - MBI Digital Equity Planning/Salem/03_Community Engagement/7. Survey/Salem+Digital+Equity_July+31,+2026_15.13.csv")
```

#Data cleaning
```{r}
survey_clean <- survey_raw |> 
  slice(3:n()) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(response_id, user_language, q11, q15, q61, race, race_7_text, q56, q80, q35)
```
q11: Hard to pay internet bill?
q15: Device
q61: How comfortable are you currently with learning new internet skills?
q56: Do you identify as Middle Eastern or North African?
q80: how do you identify
q35: income

#Crosstab
- who is struggling with these different buckets of issues - is it the same people struggling with all three or spread out 
-- internet bill "very hard" to pay; "often" "always" not enough devices; "somewhat uncomfortable" "uncomfortable" learning new skills
-- demographics: income, maybe race/ethnicity

```{r}
crosstab <- survey_clean |> 
  mutate(flag = ifelse((q11 == "Very Hard" | q11 == "Somewhat hard") & (q15 == "Always" | q15 == "Often") & (q61 == "Uncomfortable" | q61 == "Somewhat uncomfortable"), 1, 0)
         ) |> 
  group_by(flag, q35) |> 
  summarize(count = n())

test <- survey_clean |> 
  filter(q11 == "Very Hard" | q11 == "Somewhat hard") |>  #397 --> 106 
 # filter(q15 == "Always" | q15 == "Often") |>  #106 --> 10
  filter(q61 == "Uncomfortable" | q61 == "Somewhat uncomfortable") #0
```
